SELECT m.* FROM meetings m
(m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.ai_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ( m.start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.meeting_id = m.meeting_id AND t.status != 'COMPLETED' ) )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.start_time >= NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, CASE WHEN m.start_time >= NOW() THEN m.start_time END ASC, CASE WHEN m.start_time < NOW() THEN m.start_time END DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meetings ( title, start_time, persona_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{startTime}, #{personaType}, NOW() )
